description: Drill-down for one Awa queue: backlog, latency, per-kind outcomes, dispatcher behaviour, DLQ and how the queue behaves relative to its neighbours.

panels.title: Oldest job
panels.description: Age of the oldest available job in this queue.

panels.title: DLQ
panels.description: Jobs in this queue's dead-letter queue.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: failed / (completed + failed).

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Jobs completed per second, averaged over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Wait p95
panels.description: p95 time from creation to claim.

panels.title: Available
panels.description: Jobs ready to claim (upper bound: enqueued minus claimed).

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Jobs holding a lease (materialised leases only on queue storage).

panels.title: Deferred
panels.description: Scheduled plus retryable, due or not.

panels.title: Queue descriptor
panels.description: Declared display name, owner and docs for this queue, from awa_queue_info.

defaults.noValue: No descriptor declared for this queue

targets.expr: max by (awa_job_queue, awa_queue_display_name, awa_queue_owner, awa_queue_tags, awa_queue_docs_url, awa_queue_description) (awa_queue_info{awa_job_queue="$queue"})

panels.title: Depth by state
panels.description: Jobs per state in this queue.

panels.title: Queue lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest available job.

panels.title: Job wait time (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Time from creation to claim.

panels.title: Job duration (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Execution time, filtered by kind. Quantiles need AWA 0.6.13 or later; earlier versions export buckets too coarse below 5 s, so use the mean.

panels.title: Completed by kind
panels.description: Completed jobs per second.

panels.title: Failed by kind
panels.description: Failed jobs per second.

panels.title: Retried by kind
panels.description: Retried jobs per second.

panels.title: Kind summary (selected range)
panels.description: Per kind over the dashboard time range: completions, failures, retries and mean duration. Counts increments inside the selected range only.

targets.expr: sum by (awa_job_kind) (increase(awa_job_failed_total{awa_job_queue="$queue", awa_job_kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) or (sum by (awa_job_kind) (increase(awa_job_completed_total{awa_job_queue="$queue", awa_job_kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) * 0)

sum by (awa_job_kind) (increase(awa_job_retried_total{awa_job_queue="$queue", awa_job_kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) or (sum by (awa_job_kind) (increase(awa_job_completed_total{awa_job_queue="$queue", awa_job_kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) * 0)

sum by (awa_job_kind) (increase(awa_job_duration_seconds_sum{awa_job_queue="$queue", awa_job_kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) / sum by (awa_job_kind) (increase(awa_job_duration_seconds_count{awa_job_queue="$queue", awa_job_kind=~"$kind"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Claim latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Postgres dequeue query time for this queue. Quantiles need AWA 0.6.13 or later; earlier versions export buckets too coarse below 5 s, so use the mean.

panels.title: Claim batch size
panels.description: Average jobs per claim query.

panels.title: In-flight vs claim rate
panels.description: Executing jobs and claims per second. In-flight pinned at the configured concurrency with a growing backlog means workers are saturated.

panels.title: Dispatcher wake-ups by reason
panels.description: Wake-ups per second by reason.

panels.title: Empty claims & rate-limited wakes
panels.description: Wakes that found no work despite free capacity, and wakes blocked by a rate limit.

panels.title: Capacity at wake (p50) & unused permits
panels.description: Free concurrency permits when the dispatcher wakes, and permits released unused after a claim round.

panels.title: DLQ inflow by reason
panels.description: Jobs moved to the dead-letter queue per interval.

panels.title: DLQ depth
panels.description: Jobs in the dead-letter queue.

panels.title: Completion retries (deadlock / reconnect)
panels.description: Finalize retries after a Postgres deadlock abort, or after the database became unavailable (0.7+).

panels.title: Jobs parked for callback
panels.description: Jobs parked for an external callback, per second by kind.

panels.title: Maintenance rescues (all queues)
panels.description: Rescues carry no queue label, so this shows the whole fleet. A rescue burst that lines up with this queue's failures is a likely cause.

panels.title: Share of fleet in-flight
panels.description: This queue's share of all executing jobs. A share that grows while its own throughput stays flat is this queue consuming capacity other queues are waiting for.

panels.title: Claim latency p95: this queue vs others
panels.description: A claim latency that is high everywhere points at the database; high only for this queue points at the queue's own backlog or lane layout. Quantiles need AWA 0.6.13 or later; earlier versions export buckets too coarse below 5 s, so use the mean.

panels.title: Other queues' lag
panels.description: Lag of the ten other queues with the highest lag in the selected range; a spike here at the same time as this queue's in-flight share rising is contention.

targets.expr: ((max by (awa_job_queue) (awa_queue_lag_seconds{awa_job_queue!="$queue"})) and on (awa_job_queue) topk(10, max_over_time((max by (awa_job_queue) (awa_queue_lag_seconds{awa_job_queue!="$queue"}))[$__range:$__interval] @ end())))

panels.title: Other queues' wait time p95
panels.description: p95 creation-to-claim wait of the ten other queues with the highest wait in the selected range.

targets.expr: ((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, awa_job_queue) (rate(awa_job_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{awa_job_queue!="$queue"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on (awa_job_queue) topk(10, max_over_time((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, awa_job_queue) (rate(awa_job_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{awa_job_queue!="$queue"}[$__rate_interval]))))[$__range:$__interval] @ end())))

list.name: datasource
list.label: Datasource
list.description: Prometheus-compatible datasource receiving awa's OTLP metrics.

list.name: filters
list.label: Filters
list.description: Optional label filters applied to every query, for example an environment, cluster, namespace or service label that your metrics pipeline attaches to awa's series.

list.name: awa_ui_url
list.label: awa-ui base URL
list.description: Base URL of the awa-ui admin site. Panels link to awa-ui for the transactional views (pause, retry, drain) these dashboards deliberately do not duplicate.
